//BloodMoon: The blood moon itself: a self-timed hidden effect stat, the vanilla GarlicEffect shape (range 0 to max, BaseRatePerTick -1, statuses by ValueRange; Documentation/Research/HarshWilds/events_sky.md section 3 and its blood moon DECISION), built exactly like hw_stat_drought. Written ONLY by the Blood Moon collection of SelfTriggeredAction/Tgr_HW_BloodMoon.json (+HW_BLOODMOON_TICKS = 44, its max, applied Permanent by ActionRoutine when that collection is picked), then it counts itself down and rests at 0, so it needs no clearing code: armed at 18:00 to 18:45 it reaches 0 between 05:00 and 05:45. Nothing else writes it (a gate in HarshWilds-Events.Tests.ps1 reads every STA, every status effect and every C# file for a second writer). While it reads 1 to 44 its one status is active: it raises a Moderate alert when the blood moon begins (NotifyPlayer 2 NotifyWhenGoingUp, AlertLevel 2 Moderate) and shows the vanilla sprite Moon in the status strip (Visibility 0 VisibleWithStatus and StatusesHaveNoBar true, the vanilla RainValue shape for a weather condition, and the shape hw_stat_drought uses; Visibility 2 would be NeverVisible and hide the alert). The status has NO EffectsOnStats on purpose: its consumer is the framework, not a stat. HarshWilds/Animals/Lynx_BloodMoon1.json and Lynx_BloodMoon2.json name this stat in Spawn.Conditions (StatThreshold GreaterOrEqual 1), so the two extra lynxes are in the world exactly while it reads 1 or more and are retired to the Spirit World when it returns to 0. It is a GLOBAL stat, so the alert shows wherever the player is, indoors too. HW_BLOODMOON_TICKS = 44 (MinMaxValue.y, the status's ValueRange.y and the arm in Tgr_HW_BloodMoon, 11 hours) is a TUNABLE PLACEHOLDER, session-inferred and unmeasured against play; it is sized to outlast the lynx's 19 to 5 attack window from any arming tick in the 18:00 dusk hour, so retune it together with hw_clock_dusk and the status text. INFERRED, harness probe: that the collection-level StatWarpData resolves in a mod STA (measured working for hw_stat_drought on 2026-09-30) and that a save reloaded mid-night keeps the stat and its retired or restored lynxes.

Description.DefaultText: A blood moon: more lynxes hunt the forest until dawn.
The full moon hangs red tonight. Two more lynxes than usual prowl the pine groves and mountain thickets until dawn, and each may attack once.
